false_positives.comment: Reviewed against main c3d98ca4d270f2367b85ec9a96e0a14e582830ad using repository search and complete relevant source, with pinned wxWidgets 3.3.3. S5495 assumes a lambda is used only locally/synchronously. ShowSortLinesDialog also copies updateMode into each radio button's stored [updateMode] Bind callback. The radios/boxes observer arrays therefore travel inside a framework-owned callback. wxWidgets include/wx/event.h (wxEventFunctorFunctor and Bind) copies the functor into m_handler; src/common/event.cpp::DoBind retains it in m_dynamicEvents until handler destruction. The direct updateMode() call is only one use, so the rule's local-only classification misses the retained event use. Keep these value captures. Evidence: https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/event.h and https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/src/common/event.cpp .

transition_receipt.message: The issue status was successfully changed.

evidence.detail: updateMode captures radios/boxes, runs during setup, and is copied into radio->Bind callbacks.
Bind creates an allocated event functor whose member owns a copy of the supplied closure.
Dynamic entries are retained for subsequent dispatch and deleted during handler cleanup.

false_positives.comment: Reviewed against main c3d98ca4d270f2367b85ec9a96e0a14e582830ad using repository search and complete relevant source, with pinned wxWidgets 3.3.3. The changed closure in ShowTabSettingsDialog is copied into three dialog.Bind callbacks (checkbox, spin control and text), carrying its control observers and the sync closure. It is retained for later event dispatch, rather than used only as a synchronous local algorithm callback. wxWidgets include/wx/event.h::Bind allocates wxEventFunctorFunctor, whose m_handler owns a copy; src/common/event.cpp::DoBind stores that functor in the dynamic event table. S5495's local-only use premise omits these stored uses. Keep the explicit value captures. Evidence: https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/event.h and https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/src/common/event.cpp .

transition_receipt.message: The issue status was successfully changed.

evidence.detail: changed is copied into three Bind callbacks; the nested sync callable performs control synchronization.
Bind copies and stores supplied functors.
Retained dynamic handlers are invoked by later events.

false_positives.comment: Reviewed against main c3d98ca4d270f2367b85ec9a96e0a14e582830ad using repository search and complete relevant source, with pinned wxWidgets 3.3.3. NativeCompletion::Key modifies the supplied editor through its native event target: Windows SendMessageW(WM_KEYDOWN), or GTK gtk_widget_event(GDK_KEY_PRESS). EditorControl binds wxEVT_KEY_DOWN to OnKeyDown, then Core::Navigation/EditingKey invokes the mutating core keyboard handlers. Existing completion_popup and automatic_completion scenarios verify selection/confirmation and Escape cancellation on this editor. GetHandle/GetConnectWidget/GTKGetDrawingWindow are const-qualified wx accessors returning mutable native handles; their signatures hide this mutation from the rule. The corresponding editor object is modified, so S995's read-only-parameter premise is false. Header evidence: https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/window.h and https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/gtk/window.h .

transition_receipt.message: The issue status was successfully changed.

evidence.detail: Sends native key input to the addressed editor.
Key binding dispatches to editing/navigation behavior.
Native key input reaches mutating core operations.
Existing assertions observe popup cancellation through NativeCompletion::Key.

false_positives.comment: Reviewed against main c3d98ca4d270f2367b85ec9a96e0a14e582830ad using repository search and complete relevant source, with pinned wxWidgets 3.3.3. NativeCompletion::Wheel delivers WM_MOUSEWHEEL or GDK_SCROLL to the supplied editor's mutable native handle. EditorControl's wxEVT_MOUSEWHEEL binding calls Core::Wheel, which routes an active completion event to its owned popup or changes editor wheel accumulators/scroll/zoom state. tests/completion_popup.cpp::CheckPopupWheelAndFocus exercises this routing. The const-qualified wx handle getters expose writable native objects; they do not make the event operation observational. S995's unmodified-object premise is false for this input helper. Header evidence: https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/window.h and https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/gtk/window.h .

transition_receipt.message: The issue status was successfully changed.

evidence.detail: Dispatches native wheel input to the editor.
Routes active-completion wheel events to the popup and its native event handler.
Exercises active-list wheel behavior and asserts retained popup and fixed document viewport.

false_positives.comment: Reviewed against main c3d98ca4d270f2367b85ec9a96e0a14e582830ad using repository search and complete relevant source, with pinned wxWidgets 3.3.3. NativeCompletion::DoubleClick changes the supplied list through native mouse-down/up/double-click events: SendMessageW on Windows and gtk_widget_event on GTK. The actual native list updates its selection and dispatches candidate confirmation. tests/completion_popup.cpp::CheckInitialPopup verifies that this helper commits alpine, closes completion and preserves the expected Undo step; automatic_completion.cpp also exercises it. Const-qualified wx native-handle getters conceal the writable alias from S995. The list is an input target being mutated, so a pointer-to-const would describe the wrong contract. Header evidence: https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/window.h and https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/gtk/window.h .

transition_receipt.message: The issue status was successfully changed.

evidence.detail: Delivers mutating native mouse events to the addressed list.

false_positives.comment: Reviewed against main c3d98ca4d270f2367b85ec9a96e0a14e582830ad using repository search and complete relevant source, with pinned wxWidgets 3.3.3. NativeSelection::Mouse sends native button/motion input to this editor via SendMessageW or gtk_widget_event. EditorControl binds those events to Core::Mouse, which changes focus and invokes ButtonDownWithModifiers, ButtonMoveWithModifiers or ButtonUpWithModifiers to mutate its selection. tests/selection_preferences.cpp::Drag/Gestures exercises real multiple and rectangular selections. The const-qualified wx GetHandle/GetConnectWidget/GTKGetDrawingWindow accessors return mutable native handles and obscure this side effect. S995 assumes the corresponding object is not modified; that assumption is false for this input delivery helper. Evidence: https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/window.h and https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/gtk/window.h .

transition_receipt.message: The issue status was successfully changed.

evidence.detail: Sends native mouse input to the supplied editor.
Binds mouse events to Core::Mouse.

Asserts resulting native multi-selection/rectangle state and edited document bytes.

false_positives.comment: Reviewed against main c3d98ca4d270f2367b85ec9a96e0a14e582830ad using repository search and complete relevant source, with pinned wxWidgets 3.3.3. Type is a mutating native input helper. Windows sends WM_KEYDOWN/WM_CHAR/WM_KEYUP to editor->GetHandle(); GTK obtains the owning EditorFrame and calls NativeKeys::Shortcut, which targets that frame's editor. EditorControl's wxEVT_CHAR handler calls Core::Character, then InsertCharacter and RememberCurrentSelectionForRedoOntoStack. The same file's Frozen and Behavior cases verify inserted bytes, caret and Undo/Redo. The const-qualified handle/parent getters hide the writable alias from S995; the editor's document and selection history are changed. Keep EditorControl* to express that contract. Header evidence: https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/window.h .

transition_receipt.message: The issue status was successfully changed.

evidence.detail: Native typing changes the supplied editor; callers assert resulting bytes and editing history.
GTK path reaches and focuses the same frame-owned editor before sending native keys.
Native character handler converts and passes input to Core::Character.
Inserts characters and updates selection history.

false_positives.comment: Reviewed against main c3d98ca4d270f2367b85ec9a96e0a14e582830ad using repository search and complete relevant source, with pinned wxWidgets 3.3.3. TabDialog::Show obtains window from wxTopLevelWindows and wxDynamicCast(window, wxDialog) returns an alias to the same object. The callback passes that alias to edit(dialog), which changes its controls, and then calls dialog->EndModal to change the dialog's own modal state. In pinned include/wx/object.h, wxDynamicCast goes through const_cast<wxObject*> and wxCheckDynamicCast returns the original obj after the type check. This macro obscures the mutable alias; window's pointee is not a read-only observer. S5350's unmodified-object premise is therefore false. Evidence: https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/object.h .

transition_receipt.message: The issue status was successfully changed.

evidence.detail: window and dialog alias the same object; edit(dialog) and EndModal mutate it.
Representative edit callback changes spin-control values and checkbox state.
wxDynamicCast removes const qualification, checks the class, and returns the same object address.
